title: It will be a consensus candidate for Hiriyur bypoll, say BJP and JD(S) after meeting
description: Union Minister for Heavy Industries and Steel and Janata Dal (Secular) leader H.D. Kumaraswamy announced that his party, with the Bharatiya Janata Party, will field a consensus candidate in the Hiriyur Assembly bypoll, while asserting that their priority to ensure the NDA’s victory
